prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a laptop screen displaying a digital signature interface. The main focus is on a rectangular dialog box titled "Add your signature," which offers options to draw, type, or upload a signature. A hand-drawn, looping signature in dark blue ink is visible in the signature field. The interface includes buttons labeled "Clear," "Save," and "Cancel," with a subtle, modern design in light blue and white tones. The background of the screen is softly blurred, with faint text and form fields visible, suggesting an online document or contract signing process. The lower edge of the laptop keyboard is visible in the foreground, rendered in sharp focus, with metallic keys and a sleek, modern design. The lighting is soft and natural, casting gentle reflections on the screen and keyboard, creating a calm, professional atmosphere. The overall color palette is cool and muted, dominated by whites, grays, and blues, evoking a sense of modern digital workflow and efficiency. The composition uses a shallow depth of field to draw attention to the signature box, with a slight angle that adds a dynamic, documentary feel to the scene.
